summary: NHLR lists a Leflore County tower on US 82 (US 1774), last recorded intact in summer 2023; a second entry about 10 m away may be the same tower.

facts.status_note: Last recorded as standing in summer 2023; no later report found.

events.note: As of summer 2023 the glass window panes of the tower were intact, per the NHLR entry.
Registered December 31, 2023 as US 1774, MS 62, nominated by Mike Lyon.
Separate NHLR entry US 1737, MS 54 (Leflore Lookout Tower), registered July 9, 2023, about 10 m from these coordinates. May be the same tower.

evidence.supports: little is known; tower along US 82
evidence.quote: Little is known about this tower along US 82.

evidence.supports: as of summer 2023 window panes intact
evidence.quote: As of summer 2023, the glass window panes of the tower were intact.

evidence.supports: Leflore entry coordinates, about 10 m from Greenwood entry
120ft Aermotor LS-40 over the Mississippi Delta
evidence.quote: This tower stands over the flat lands of the Mississippi Delta. The tower is a 120ft Aermotor LS-40.

corrections.proposed: Also check NHLR US 1737, MS 54 (Leflore Lookout Tower), about 10 m away, which may be the same tower registered twice
corrections.why: Both entries are in Leflore County with nearly identical coordinates, but they have different registration dates and nominators, so a merge decision is needed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The two entries give different elevations for nearly the same spot: 139 ft (42 m) for Greenwood and 136 ft (41 m) for Leflore. The brief's 42.4 m is kept for the Greenwood record.

notes_for_editor: Probable duplicate: the Greenwood (US 1774) and Leflore (US 1737) entries sit about 10 m apart in Leflore County, but the register does not say they are one tower and the nominators differ (Mike Lyon vs Jason Johns). The story keeps them separate and says so. Only two register pages found for this site after two searches each; the local-history searches turned up nothing. The Leflore entry's MFC administration and 120-ft Aermotor are not attributed to the Greenwood record in facts.
